mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_icon AS userIcon, u.user_nickname AS userNickname FROM users u WHERE u.friend_code = #{friendCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friends (requester_id, receiver_id, friend_status) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{receiverId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT f.friend_relation_id AS friendRelationId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_icon AS userIcon, u.user_nickname AS userNickname FROM friends f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN f.requester_id = #{userId} THEN f.receiver_id ELSE f.requester_id END WHERE f.friend_status = 1 AND (f.requester_id = #{userId} OR f.receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY f.friend_relation_id DESC

SELECT f.friend_relation_id AS friendRelationId, u.user_icon AS userIcon, u.user_nickname AS userNickname FROM friends f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.receiver_id WHERE f.friend_status = 0 AND f.requester_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.friend_relation_id DESC

SELECT f.friend_relation_id AS friendRelationId, u.user_icon AS userIcon, u.user_nickname AS userNickname FROM friends f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.requester_id WHERE f.friend_status = 0 AND f.receiver_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.friend_relation_id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friends WHERE friend_relation_id = #{friendRelationId} AND friend_status = 1 AND (requester_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId})
